text_block_list.text:
"City might run the Tiara tour!"
"You
mean we'll get to see her wear the Triple

Tiara?!"
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
"I literally can't wait!"
...Get it?
Everyone's talking about you!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
(That's Тосэн Джордан, a friend of Gold
City's. She
can come off as a bit
unmotivated at times.)

They're getting way too hyped up. I
haven't even
decided if I'm doing the
Tiara tour yet.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Buuut... going for the Hanshin J.F. means
you're
leaning in that direction pretty
hard, right?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: ...Maybe.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you can tell me! Aren't we
BFFs? ☆
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Since when?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Seriously?! You're so cold!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: But anyways, you would look so, so pretty with the tiara.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Oops, sorry. But come on, aren't you a
bit too
sensitive about the word? I mean,
it's just a fact.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I know everyone means it as a
compliment, and
look, I'm grateful for
that.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But that's not the real me. That's just
some
ornament decorated by someone
else.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
When I hear that word, I want to kick
myself for
not being able to leave any
other impression.
That's why I don't like
hearing it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Who here thinks City gets way too deep
about
these things? Meeee.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Listen. If that really bothers you, why
don't you
stop modeling for a while?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
That would only mean I'm running away.
I want to
prove I can be even better as a
runner than as a
model.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Besides, the industry has done so much
for me,
and my schedule is already
booked for the next
few years.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Dang, you're so popular! Slay. ♪
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough about that. Show me
more of
what people are saying.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna, 'cause you said we aren't
BFFs.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't make that scary face! Fine,
have it
your way.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
By the way, wanna hit up the cafeteria?
I'm
starving.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: They're rooting for me, huh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Um, Miss City? Can I, like, have my
phone back
now?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Hold on.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's surprising. All the comments are so
positive.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I figured people would be more
dismissive. Like,
"stay on the runway" or
"what's a model gonna
do?"
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wait, so you were putting off searching
your
name 'cause you were scared?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Hah, spot on? What's up with that,
though? You
don't let haters get to you
one bit when you're
modeling!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Racing is different. Like I said, I'm doing
this as
the real me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I don't fully get it, but at least
everyone's
looking forward to seeing
you run.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Sounds like it. They really have high
hopes for
me...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Bzzzt...
Oh, it's a text from my manager.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, your manager... She's so scary. I bet
you she
hates me.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: I don't think so.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I get the same vibe from your trainer
too. Why're
you always attracting the
hardcore types?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: That's what I wanna know... Oh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara would be well suited
for you. I
can adjust your work schedule,
so just let me
know whatever you need."
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
No way. Your manager is actually
backing your
decision to race?!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's what it looks like. I can
barely
believe it either.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's awesome! I'm so happy for
you, City!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Although she made it sound like it's a
favor.
Adjusting my schedule is literally
her job.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Come on, stop trying to play it cool. I
see you
smiling! ☆
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Shut up.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I have to do my best. No holding back!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
